reasoning_effort: Use exactly the effort selected by the stage-08 readiness gate, frozen in deployment.json before calls.
design: Balanced three human-rating bands x one/multiple solver moves. Exclude all 222 previously sampled/reserved puzzle IDs.
outcome: Assisted exact official first UCI move. FEN, piece list and unranked legal choices supplied. No engine, tools or solution supplied.
request_policy: Plain final UCI; identical header-paced collector from stage 08; no correctness-based retries; quota deferrals resume without replacing terminal outcomes.
primary_analysis: Exploratory binomial logistic regression: success ~ (rating-1500)/500 + indicator(multiple solver moves), among completed provider responses; format/length/illegal output count as failures. Provider errors and quota deferrals are not chess outcomes and are separately reported.
analysis_gate: All 60 puzzle positions attempted; at least 58 completed provider responses and at least 15 successes and 15 failures. Otherwise no regression or tree is fitted.
tree: Descriptive depth-2 tree on rating, solver-move count and legal-move count; min leaf=10; no out-of-sample accuracy claim.
scope: Early results for one model, prompt and deployment. Balanced sample and legal-choice assistance limit generalization. No claim of full-sequence solving or calibrated population accuracy.
final_answer_normalization: Same checked whole-answer legal UCI/canonical SAN normalization as stage 08, frozen before any research calls.
